description: This file defines a WebSocket client class for interacting with OpenAI's Whisper transcription API via real-time streaming. It manages connection setup, session configuration, real-time audio data transmission, prompt updates, and reconnection logic, emitting events for transcription updates and errors.

classes.name: OpenAIWhisperClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client class for real-time transcription with OpenAI Whisper API, supporting connection management, session configuration, audio streaming, prompt updates, and event handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the OpenAI Whisper API, configuring the session for transcription-only mode.

methods.name: setupWebSocketHandlers
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for WebSocket events such as open, message, error, and close.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the WebSocket session for transcription-only mode with local VAD enabled and sends initial session parameters.

methods.name: updateTranscriptionPrompt
methods.description: Dynamically updates the transcription prompt during an active session.

methods.name: handleServerMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the server, emitting relevant events for transcription updates, errors, and completion.

methods.name: sendInputBufferCommit
methods.description: Sends a manual commit to force transcription of buffered audio.

methods.name: sendAudioChunk
methods.description: Sends a PCM16 audio chunk to the API, queuing if session is not yet configured.

methods.name: flushPendingAudioChunks
methods.description: Sends all queued audio chunks after session configuration.

methods.name: scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules a reconnection attempt with exponential backoff.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and resets internal state.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the client is currently connected and session is active.

methods.name: getConnectionState
methods.description: Returns the current connection state: connecting, connected, disconnected, or reconnecting.
